text: dsh-any-rollback 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的对话与工作区回退插件，通过宿主命令和会话界面入口，让用户回到较早的消息并按对应快照恢复文件。它提供消息回退、工作区文件快照与恢复、重新生成历史轮次，以及快照清理管理。适合需要在同一会话中撤回错误步骤并重试的 DSH 用户。备份保存在本机 DSH 快照目录；源码未显示需要 API Key 或外部账号。
dsh-any-rollback rewinds DSH web conversations and restores matching workspace snapshots. Use its session controls or commands to rewind, rerun an earlier prompt, and manage local snapshot cleanup.
我想回到前几条消息之前继续聊。
撤回对话时也把工作区文件恢复到当时的状态。
能不能从某条旧消息重新发送提示词再跑一遍？
想查看并清理本机积累的会话快照。
Can I rewind a chat and restore its workspace files to the same point?
I want to rerun an earlier prompt and manage the saved snapshots.
dsh-any-rollback 的功能「对话与文件回退」：把会话回到指定消息之前，并根据快照恢复对应工作区文件；未能直接还原的文件可移入隔离目录保留。用户可通过 /rewind、/undo 或消息旁的回退界面触发。
dsh-any-rollback 的功能「重新生成与快照管理」：从较早消息重新发送原提示词，或查看并调整快照自动清理策略。用户可用 /regen 重新生成，用 /snapshot-auto-cleanup 查看状态、设置清理策略或执行清理。
dsh-any-rollback 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 6 天；提交数 38；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-any-rollback README · dsh-any-rollback：> **DSH 对话回退插件。** 回退到任意一条历史消息，并把工作区文件一起还原 ——
> 包括渲染、ffmpeg、构建脚本这类**命令产出的文件**，不只是编辑器里改过的源码。
> 不 fork 会话、不开新窗口，就在当前对话里原地回退。
>
> English version: [README.en.md](README.en.md)

dsh-any-rollback README · 它解决什么问题：用 AI 干活时，一个回合经常同时留下两类痕迹：对话里的消息，和工作区里的文件。想「回到那一步重来」时，
两者都得回到当时的样子才对 —— 只退对话会留下一地改了半截的文件，只退文件则对话还停在错误的上下文里。

`dsh-any-rollback` 把这两件事一起做：点消息上的 ↶，对话回到那条消息之前，文件也回到那一刻的状态。

| 场景 | 没有本插件 | 使用本插件 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 生成视频的脚本跑了 3 版，想回到第 1 版 | 得手动清理 `out/` 里一堆 mp4 | 回退即还原，旧版本移入隔离区 |
| 让 AI 重构，改错了想撤回 | 对话回退后文件仍是坏的 | 对话和文件一起回到改前 |
| 多轮试错，想从某一步重来 | 开新会话，丢失上下文 | 原地回退，同窗口继续 |

dsh-any-rollback README · 1. 按消息回退对话：每条用户消息旁有 ↶ 按钮。点它，这条消息之后的内容从对话视图上撤下（会话日志仍只追加、不删除，可追溯），
输入框自动填回被撤回的那句话，改一改就能重新提问。**输入框里原有的内容会被替换**（并弹一句提示），
这样连续回退到不同消息时，输入框里始终是当前这条被撤回的话。

也可以直接用命令：

| 命令 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `/rewind <序号>` | 回退到第 N 条用户消息之前 |
| `/rewind @<seq>` | 按会话内序号回退 |
| `/undo` | 取消上一次回退 |

dsh-any-rollback README · 2. 同时还原工作区文件：回退时可选择只退对话、只退文件，或两者都退。文件还原依据的是**插件自己的备份目录**，
不猜测、不推断：只写回真正备份过的内容。

dsh-any-rollback README · 3. 追踪命令产出的文件（本插件的重点能力）：大多数工具只备份模型调用 `write` / `edit` 改过的文件。可 AI 干活时更常见的产物是命令生成的：
`node render.mjs` 出的帧序列、`ffmpeg` 合成的视频、构建脚本写进 `dist/` 的产物、数据脚本导出的
`*.parquet`。这些文件没人「编辑」过，常规做法完全不管它们。

本插件在每个回合边界记录一份工作区清单（`路径 → 大小 + mtime + sha256`），
**只对发生变化**的文件按内容摘要缓存（相同字节重复渲染不额外占空间），回退时逐文件判断：

| 目标时刻的状态 | 现在 | 处理方式 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 存在，内容已缓存 | 不同或已缺失 | 还原备份的字节 |
| 不存在 | 存在（命令新建的产物） | 移入隔离区，不删除 |
| 存在，内容未缓存（超大或未缓存） | 不同或缺失 | 移入隔离区，并提示「需要时重新生成」 |
section: 3. 追踪命令产出的文件（本插件的重点能力）

dsh-any-rollback README · 4. 快照存储与配额（v0.19.1-any.19 起）：> **背景：** 早期版本把每份内容按 `<会话ID>/artifacts/blobs/<sha256>` 各存一份，
> 同一份 64 MiB 的视频在 3 个会话里就存 3 份。实测一个 `~/.dsh/rewind-snapshots/`
> 长到 **42 GB**：103,784 个 blob 里只有 27,370 份唯一内容，**26.36 GiB 是纯跨会话重复**。
> 而且自动清理默认关闭、按「闲置 30 天」判定，几天内产生的大量快照根本清不掉。

现在内容一律进**全局内容寻址仓** `<root>/_blobs/<hash前2位>/<hash>`：所有会话共享同一份
字节，相同内容全机只存一次；旧版每会话 blob 仍可读，通过 `compact` 逐步收编。清理策略
默认开启，且增加了**总配额**（默认 8 GB）：

dsh-any-rollback README · 4. 快照存储与配额（v0.19.1-any.19 起）：| 命令 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `/snapshot-auto-cleanup` | 查看状态（开关 / 闲置天数 / 总配额 / 压缩开关 / 已用空间） |
| `/snapshot-auto-cleanup on\|off` | 启用 / 停用自动清理 |
| `/snapshot-auto-cleanup max-age <天数>` | 设置闲置天数上限 |
| `/snapshot-auto-cleanup max-total <GB>` | 设置全局总配额（`0` = 不限，默认 8） |
| `/snapshot-auto-cleanup compact [--apply]` | 预演 / 执行：旧 blob 收编进全局仓 + 全局可达性 GC + 按配额淘汰最旧会话 |
| `/snapshot-auto-cleanup run [--apply]` | 清理 + 压缩：预演，或执行 |
| `/snapshot-auto-cleanup run --current [--apply]` | 只清理当前会话的备份 |
section: 4. 快照存储与配额（v0.19.1-any.19 起）

text:
dsh-any-rollback README · 4. 快照存储与配额（v0.19.1-any.19 起）：配额淘汰是**整组会话**为单位、按最旧优先；含隔离区 / `rescue/` / `.pending/` 的会话
不会被淘汰（那些是用户尚未取回的原始字节）。删除前一律先预演。

**存量数据一次性止血**（默认只读预演、加 `--apply --yes` 才执行，绝不碰隔离区）：

```powershell
node scripts/snapshot-doctor.mjs                     # 体检，报告可释放空间
node scripts/snapshot-doctor.mjs --json             # 机器可读
node scripts/snapshot-doctor.mjs --apply --dedup --gc --yes   # 跨会话硬链接去重 + 回收孤儿 blob
```

`--dedup` 用硬链接合并重复副本（先逐份校验 sha256），`--gc` 删除不被任何清单引用的
孤儿 blob，两者都会写审计日志 `dedup-log.jsonl`，可在同目录人工核对。
section: 4. 快照存储与配额（v0.19.1-any.19 起）

text: dsh-any-rollback README · 5. 设置卡片：在 DSH 插件页有独立配置卡片，可开关文件备份、调整自动清理策略，不用改配置文件。

dsh-any-rollback README · 配置项：| 键 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fileCheckpointingEnabled` | `true` | 是否记录新的文件备份 |
| `maxFileBytes` | `8388608`（8 MiB） | 单文件备份上限，`0` 表示不限制 |
| `snapshotDir` | `~/.dsh/rewind-snapshots/` | 备份存放根目录 |
| `artifactTrackingEnabled` | `true` | 是否追踪命令产出的文件 |
| `artifactMaxFileBytes` | `67108864`（64 MiB） | 命令产物单文件缓存上限，独立于 `maxFileBytes` |
| `artifactBaselineContent` | `false` | 是否缓存首次观测到的内容（更占空间，能还原插件未见过历史的大文件） |
| `artifactExclude` | `node_modules,dist,build,out,coverage,__pycache__,venv,.venv,target` | 追踪时跳过的目录 |
| `artifactKeepManifests` | `20` | 每个会话保留的清单份数 |
| `autoCleanupEnabled` | `true` | 自动清理开关（默认开启，防止再次无声涨到 40 GB） |
| `autoCleanupMaxAgeDays` | `30` | 备份闲置多少天后可清理 |
| `autoCleanupMaxTotalGb` | `8` | 全局总配额（GiB），`0` = 不限；超出时按最旧会话整组淘汰 |
| `autoCleanupCompact` | `true` | 自动清理时是否顺带压缩（跨会话去重 + 全局 GC） |

dsh-any-rollback README · 数据放在哪里：```
~/.dsh/rewind-snapshots/
  _blobs/<前2位>/<sha256>   # 全局内容仓：所有会话共享，相同字节全机一份
  <会话ID>/
    <消息序号>/            # 每条消息对应的文件备份

备份目录与工作区分离（不是工作区的子目录）。删掉这个目录只会丢失回退能力，不会影响项目文件本身。

dsh-any-rollback README · 从 Release 安装（推荐）：在 profile 的 `package.json` 中加依赖：

```json
"dependencies": {
  "dsh-any-rollback": "https://github.com/xinstart-1/dsh-any-rollback/releases/download/v0.19.1-any.9/dsh-any-rollback-0.19.1-any.9.tgz"
}
```

安装并重启 DSH：

dsh-any-rollback README · 从 Release 安装（推荐）：```powershell
$node = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\node\bin\node.exe"
$pnpm = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\pnpm\bin\pnpm.mjs"
& $node $pnpm install --dir "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\<profile>" --prefer-offline
```

还要确认 `dsh-any-rollback` 已加入该 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组 —— **这个数组才是真正加载插件的开关**。

dsh-any-rollback README · 从源码目录安装：```json
"dsh-any-rollback": "file:C:/path/to/dsh-any-rollback/dist/dsh-any-rollback-0.19.1-any.9.tgz"
```

dsh-any-rollback README · 校验安装：```powershell
node scripts\verify.mjs                  # 检查当前桌面 profile
node scripts\verify.mjs "<包目录>"        # 检查任意解包目录
```

期望的 SHA-256：

| 文件 | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| `lib/index.js` | `eba61cdff42870e65efe6460b8c6e6b90691a4b9133882d27c2d64e41e9c8946` |
| `lib/artifact-track.js` | `a2ce62be39cf34aacf168ca197e6bc44c55944f716255a8cfac3b2c72fa0f977` |
| `lib/client.js` | `dc85d3d331b442234513717097ba487b1d936c8972ac03f31a39fcecc94b8c30` |

dsh-any-rollback README · 校验安装：> tarball 自身的摘要会随包内 README 变化（自引用），因此不写死在文档里；
> 以 `dist/` 下实际文件为准（`Get-FileHash` / `sha256sum`），或直接对照 Release 附件页。

装完**重启 DSH** 才会生效（插件宿主侧每个进程只加载一次）。重启后跑一个回合，
确认 `~\.dsh\rewind-snapshots\<会话ID>\artifacts\manifests\` 下出现清单文件，且消息旁出现 ↶ 按钮。

dsh-any-rollback README · 卸载：从 profile 的 `dependencies` 和 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里删掉 `dsh-any-rollback`，重新安装依赖即可。
备份数据不会自动删除；要彻底清理，手动删除 `~/.dsh/rewind-snapshots/`。

dsh-any-rollback README · 设计取舍：- **只写回真正备份过的内容。** 宁可少还原，也不用推断去覆盖文件。
- **不删除任何文件。** 回退时要移出的文件一律进隔离区。
- **会话日志只追加。** 回退只改变对话视图，历史记录永远完整可查。
- **备份目录独立于工作区。** 不会污染项目，也不会被项目里的清理脚本误删。
dsh-any-rollback README · 已修复的问题：以下四处在早期版本中确实存在，本版已修复，并各有回归测试守着（`tests/artifact-track.regression.mjs`）。

dsh-any-rollback README · 1. 超上限且内容改过的文件会被移出工作区 → 已修复：单文件超过上限（`maxFileBytes` / `artifactMaxFileBytes`）时内容不被缓存。早期版本遇到「目标时刻已存在、
但内容没备份且后来改过」的文件，会按「新建产物」处理并移入隔离区，看起来像文件被删了。

现在改为**跳过并保持原样**，回退结果里会写明「N 个文件保持原样（目标时刻没有内容备份）」。
目标时刻**确实没有**该文件时，仍然会移入隔离区 —— 这是正确行为，未改变。

dsh-any-rollback README · 2. 1.5 秒内的同尺寸改写可能漏记 → 已修复：早期用「大小 + mtime，mtime 带 1500 ms 容差」判断变化。若文件在边界之后**大小不变、且在容差窗口内被改写**，
会沿用旧摘要，回退还原成更早的版本。

现在改为 **mtime 精确比对**：只有 mtime 完全相同才复用旧摘要，否则重新计算内容哈希。

text:
dsh-any-rollback README · 3. 内容缓存从不回收 → 已修复：早期只裁剪清单，`artifacts/blobs/` 里的内容副本永不删除，会话越长占用越大。

现在每次裁剪清单后执行一次**可达性回收**：清掉不再被任何存活清单引用的 blob，
以及写入中断留下的 `.tmp-*` 临时文件。

dsh-any-rollback README · 4. 点目录不参与追踪 → 已修复：早期扫描跳过所有 `.` 开头的目录，产物落在 `.output/`、`.cache/` 里就不会被追踪。

现在默认**追踪点目录**，只固定跳过 VCS 与工具状态目录（`.git`、`.hg`、`.svn`、`.dsh`、`.dsh-file-attachment`）。
依赖与构建目录（`node_modules`、`dist`、`build`、`out` 等）仍按默认排除；

dsh-any-rollback README · dsh-any-rollback：> **In-window conversation rewind for DSH.** Rewind to any earlier user message and restore the workspace
> with it — including files produced by commands (`node render.mjs`, `ffmpeg`, build and data scripts),
> not just source files handled by an editor tool. No session forking, no new window: the rewind happens
> in place.
>
> 中文版：[README.md](README.md)

dsh-any-rollback README · The problem：A turn of agent work usually leaves two kinds of traces: messages in the conversation, and files on disk.
"Go back to that step and try again" only works if both return to their earlier state — rewinding the
conversation alone leaves half-edited files behind, and restoring files alone leaves the model in the
wrong context.

`dsh-any-rollback` does both: click ↶ on a message and the conversation returns to just before it, with the
workspace restored to how it looked at that moment.

dsh-any-rollback README · The problem：| Situation | Without this plugin | With it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Three iterations of a render script, back to the first | clean up a pile of mp4 files by hand | one rewind restores them; newer files move to quarantine |
| A refactor went wrong | conversation rewinds, files stay broken | conversation and files return together |
| Several failed attempts, restart from one step | open a new session, lose context | rewind in place, same window |

dsh-any-rollback README · 1. Rewind the conversation by message：Every user message has a ↶ button. It withdraws everything after that message from the conversation view
(the session log stays append-only and fully auditable), and puts the withdrawn text back in the composer so
you can edit and resend. **Whatever was already in the composer is replaced** (a brief notice says so), so
rewinding to different messages always leaves the current withdrawn text in place.

Commands work too:

dsh-any-rollback README · 1. Rewind the conversation by message：| Command | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `/rewind <index>` | rewind to just before the Nth user message |
| `/rewind @<seq>` | rewind by in-session sequence number |
| `/undo` | revert the last rewind |

dsh-any-rollback README · 2. Restore workspace files at the same time：A rewind can restore the conversation only, the files only, or both. File restores read **only the plugin's
own backup directory** — it never guesses, and only writes back content it actually backed up.
section: 2. Restore workspace files at the same time

text:
dsh-any-rollback README · 3. Track files produced by commands (the part most tools miss)：Most implementations back up only files the model touched through `write` / `edit`. But agent work usually
produces files through commands: frame sequences from `node render.mjs`, a video muxed by `ffmpeg`, build
output in `dist/`, a data script's `*.parquet`. Nothing ever "edited" them, so conventional checkpoints
ignore them entirely.
section: 3. Track files produced by commands (the part most tools miss)

text:
dsh-any-rollback README · 3. Track files produced by commands (the part most tools miss)：This plugin writes a workspace manifest at each turn boundary (`path → size + mtime + sha256`) and caches
content **only for entries that changed**, keyed by digest, so re-rendering identical bytes costs nothing.
On a rewind it decides per file:
section: 3. Track files produced by commands (the part most tools miss)

text:
dsh-any-rollback README · 3. Track files produced by commands (the part most tools miss)：| At the target state | Now | Action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| existed, content cached | different or missing | restore the cached bytes |
| absent | exists (created by a command) | move to quarantine, never delete |
| existed, content not cached (too large / uncached) | different or missing | move to quarantine, report "regenerate if needed" |

text:
dsh-any-rollback README · 3. Track files produced by commands (the part most tools miss)：**Quarantine only moves, never deletes**: bytes stay on disk with their origin recorded in `index.json`.
Losing a two-hour render to a rewind would be unacceptable, so the plugin spends disk space instead.
section: 3. Track files produced by commands (the part most tools miss)

text:
dsh-any-rollback README · 4. Automatic snapshot cleanup：Backups take space, so they are pruned by policy: an on/off switch, an idle-age cutoff, and a manual sweep.

| Command | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `/snapshot-auto-cleanup` | show current status |
| `/snapshot-auto-cleanup on\|off` | enable / disable auto cleanup |
| `/snapshot-auto-cleanup max-age <days>` | set the idle cutoff |
| `/snapshot-auto-cleanup run [--apply]` | dry run, or actually sweep |
| `/snapshot-auto-cleanup run --current [--apply]` | sweep only this session |

dsh-any-rollback README · 5. Settings card：A dedicated card on the DSH Plugins page covers the backup switch and the cleanup policy, so no config file
editing is needed.

dsh-any-rollback README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fileCheckpointingEnabled` | `true` | record new file backups |
| `maxFileBytes` | `8388608` (8 MiB) | per-file backup cap; `0` disables it |
| `snapshotDir` | `~/.dsh/rewind-snapshots/` | backup root |
| `artifactTrackingEnabled` | `true` | track command-produced files |
| `artifactMaxFileBytes` | `67108864` (64 MiB) | per-file cache cap for artifacts, independent of `maxFileBytes` |
| `artifactBaselineContent` | `false` | also cache the first observation (costlier; restores large pre-existing content) |
| `artifactExclude` | `node_modules,dist,build,out,coverage,__pycache__,venv,.venv,target` | subtrees skipped while tracking |
| `artifactKeepManifests` | `20` | manifests kept per session |
| `autoCleanupEnabled` | `true` | automatic cleanup switch |
| `autoCleanupMaxAgeDays` | `30` | idle days before a backup may be swept |

dsh-any-rollback README · Where data lives：```
~/.dsh/rewind-snapshots/<sessionId>/
  <messageSeq>/          # per-message file backups
  artifacts/
    manifests/           # one workspace manifest per turn boundary

The backup root is a sibling of the workspace, never a subtree of it. Deleting it loses rewind history but
never touches project files.

dsh-any-rollback README · Uninstall：Remove `dsh-any-rollback` from the profile's `dependencies` and `dsh.profile.bundles`, then reinstall. Backup
data is not deleted automatically — remove `~/.dsh/rewind-snapshots/` to wipe it.

dsh-any-rollback README · Design decisions：- **Only write back what was backed up.** Prefer restoring less over overwriting with a guess.
- **Never delete a file.** Anything that must leave the worktree goes to quarantine.
- **The session log is append-only.** A rewind changes the conversation view; history stays complete.
- **The backup root is separate from the workspace.** It cannot be clobbered by project clean scripts.

dsh-any-rollback README · Fixed in this version：All four behaviours below existed in earlier builds. They are fixed here, and each has a regression test in
`tests/artifact-track.regression.mjs`.

dsh-any-rollback README · 1. An over-cap file that changed was moved out of the worktree → fixed：Content is not cached for a file above the cap (`maxFileBytes` / `artifactMaxFileBytes`). An earlier build
treated such a file as "newly created" when it had changed, so a rewind moved a file that legitimately
existed at the target state into quarantine — it looked deleted.
section: 1. An over-cap file that changed was moved out of the worktree → fixed

text:
dsh-any-rollback README · 1. An over-cap file that changed was moved out of the worktree → fixed：Now it is **skipped and left in place**, and the rewind reports "N file(s) left as-is (no content backup for
that point)". A file that genuinely did not exist at the target state is still quarantined; that is correct
and unchanged.
section: 1. An over-cap file that changed was moved out of the worktree → fixed

text:
dsh-any-rollback README · 2. A same-size rewrite within 1.5 s could be missed → fixed：Change detection used `size + mtime` with a 1500 ms mtime tolerance, so a same-size rewrite right after a
boundary reused the previous digest and a rewind restored content older than the target state.

Now mtime is compared **exactly**: the previous digest is reused only when mtime is identical, otherwise the
content is hashed again.
section: 2. A same-size rewrite within 1.5 s could be missed → fixed

text:
dsh-any-rollback README · 3. The content cache was never reclaimed → fixed：Only manifests were pruned, so every cached copy under `artifacts/blobs/` stayed forever.

Each prune now runs a **reachability sweep**: blobs no longer referenced by any live manifest are removed,
along with `.tmp-*` files left by an interrupted write.
section: 3. The content cache was never reclaimed → fixed

text:
dsh-any-rollback README · 4. Dot-directories were not tracked → fixed：The walk used to skip every directory starting with `.`, so artifacts under `.output/` or `.cache/` were
invisible. Dot-directories are now tracked by default, with only VCS/tooling state skipped
(`.git`, `.hg`, `.svn`, `.dsh`, `.dsh-file-attachment`). Dependency and build directories (`node_modules`,
`dist`, `build`, `out`, …) stay excluded by default; `artifactExclude` still overrides the list.

dsh-any-rollback README · Remaining boundaries：- Rewinding needs existing backups. History from before the plugin was installed, or changes made while
  backups were off, has no record and cannot be restored.
- After a conversation compaction, messages earlier than the compaction point drop out of the rewind list.
- Files above the size cap are not cached, so changes that cross the cap cannot be restored (the rewind now
  says so explicitly and leaves the file alone).

lib/      host and client entry points
locale/   interface copy
scripts/  verify.mjs (integrity check), refresh.ps1 (re-sync an installed copy)
